Structural: a page whose candidates were review-rejected can never be regenerated in the live tree. A fresh campaign id refuses because pre-existing untracked outputs are unreceipted (campaign_manifest.py:432, allow_existing_accepted comes only from the campaign's OWN ledger), and resuming the original id re-gates the existing bytes rather than re-translating (campaign_runner.py:405 on config_fingerprint advance). The only tree-cleaning move is deleting content, which is barred. Hit on 2 pages now (introducing-cells-foss-go 17 files, words-document-net 11), so it is structural, not incidental. Needs an operator-reviewed mechanism -- candidate: subtract declared replace_existing paths in the campaign_scoped branch as the sibling branch at campaign_manifest.py:393 already does, IF that asymmetry is an oversight. RESOLVED by a peer session in 5ee0fd3: the require_clean/campaign_scoped branch now subtracts set(declared), matching line ~393. Two tests pin both directions -- a declared+dirty target no longer blocks, an UNDECLARED dirty output still does -- and _run_campaign_job's per-job 'declared replacement pre-hash drift' check is untouched as the real safety net. tests/unit/workers: 605 passed, 1 skipped.

Link-bearing paragraphs are leaf-split by _has_technical_content (text_unit_extractor.py:2171-2173), so TC-APT-036's sentence-integrity half never took effect. CORRECTED 2026-09-05: the obvious one-line fix (delete the LINK trigger) is FALSIFIED -- it drops the URL from every link in a whole-extracted node (identity round-trip went 14/14 -> 0/14 byte-identical on real pages). Extraction and placeholder restore are both correct in isolation; the renderer emits the structural LINK child instead of the applied text and loses the URL. Fix the RENDERER first, re-run the neutrality harness to 14/14, and only then remove the extractor trigger. CONFIRMED ACROSS LOCALES 2026-09-05: the untranslated pre-link fragment recurs at line 431, identical position, in 4 of 11 locales (fa/he/sv/zh, three scripts, both directions); all 3 in-prose links in fa are defective. This is now the top producer defect blocking this page. LANDED 2026-09-05. The falsification held until the renderer bug behind it was fixed: markdown-it-py 4.x Token.attrs is a dict but the re-parse iterated it as tuples, so every re-parsed link lost its URL (peer, e065151). With that in place the identity round-trip is 14/14 WITH the trigger removed, so the extractor change is output-neutral and is now landed. The target paragraph went from 3 fragments to ONE 664-char unit.

U+202F NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE is injected where the source has none (nl 2, fa 1) but is LEGITIMATE typography in fr (21 occurrences, French uses it before ; : ! ?). normalize_injected_invisibles has no locale awareness, so adding U+202F would delete 21 correct French spaces to remove 3 injected ones. Needs locale-aware normalization or a review-level rule; deliberately not fixed blind. Same category as the U+00A0 exclusion, whose original reasoning this vindicates.

Governed terminology is duplicated across FOUR inventories that must agree but are edited independently: profile preserve_patterns, engine.py _FRONTMATTER_TECHNICAL_SIGNAL_RE, config/terminology.yaml, and verification/checks/language_check.py TECHNICAL_SIGNAL_RE. Governing one term took four commits across three iterations, and each miss produced a distinct live failure. The two regexes are near-copies that will keep drifting. Candidate fix: derive both signal regexes from the terminology config so there is one source of truth, or at minimum a test that fails when they disagree (one such test now exists for the single governed term). RESOLVED 2026-09-06: both signal regexes now derive their governed multi-word terms from config/terminology.yaml via translation_engine/governed_terms.py. The drift was 15 governed terms in config vs 1 in the regexes, so API Reference, REST API, QR Code, Data Matrix and the barcode symbologies were all counted as prose -- reaching reference.aspose.org and the barcode families, not just one page. A parametrized drift guard now fails if the two paths disagree about any governed term.

Proactive validator-FP calibration sweep: full ValidationSuite+gates over shipped-approved corpus (every flag = FP class) + stratified 200-cell battery; fix classes in one batch with fixtures PILOT 2026-09-06: sweep script built and run over 150 shipped cells -- 90.7% carry at least one flag, 146 classes. BUT the 'any flag on a shipped cell is a false positive' premise does not hold for this corpus: 94% of flags are folder-layout, the pairs were verified to be genuine translations (fences/headings align), and the list-item divergences (en 25 vs fa 7, en 32 vs id 2) are real missing content. The sweep is two inventories -- legacy defects AND false positives -- and must be separated per class. Restrict FP claims to cells shipped under the current review standard. RESULT 2026-09-06: 0 flags across all 62 cells shipped under the CURRENT review standard (isolated via the mission's own commit convention, not a date range). No FP epidemic exists at this layer; the 90.7% rate is entirely legacy corpus, and those are real historical defects. The 'doubling amplifies undiscovered FP classes' risk is therefore measured at zero for the current standard.

Stray unmatched ']' emitted after a list-item link, rendering as a visible literal bracket. Measured on introducing-cells-foss-go: bracket balance 25/26 against source 25/25 in de, el, id, he; the other 8 locales balanced. Invisible to link-count checks because a stray ']' forms no link. Inferred mechanism (unverified): the tail-only link preserve_pattern hands the model an unbalanced '[', it closes the bracket after the placeholder, and restore expands to '](url)]'. Bracket-balance-vs-source is now in the mechanical pre-check. FIXED 2026-09-06. Mechanism VERIFIED not inferred: two sites, and the L272 shape carried an orphan '{' -- a broken placeholder token, which only occurs when the model edits around a raw '[' beside a placeholder. Site 1 (brand label, de/el/id/he) is covered by TC-APT-085; site 2 (API Reference, pl/pt/ro) by a lookahead-scoped preserve_pattern that masks a link's opening bracket. Neutrality 14/14; prose and code brackets untouched. RETRIGGERED 2026-09-06 as heal-cells-go-w2 (20 cells). Masking verified on the real page first: 0 link lines hand the model a raw bracket. STEP 2 CONFIRMED 2026-09-06 on the original failing page: bracket balance 25/25 in 3 of 3 previously-broken cells (de, el, he were 25/26).

Governed brand-navigation labels are unprotected on the LIST_ITEM extraction path. The same label inside a paragraph link survives 17/18 locales; alone in a list item, 8/18. The brand-nav-label check runs on the paragraph LINK path (text_unit_extractor.py:1759) but not on the full-sentence/LIST_ITEM path. 'API Reference' survives there only via its own terminology.yaml entry. Fix: apply the check on the LIST_ITEM path, or register the label shape in terminology.yaml so it routes through the derived governed-terms machinery. FIXED 2026-09-06 via _whole_node_is_brand_navigation_link on the full-sentence path. First attempt was inert (tested raw markdown, not anchor text) and the real page caught it. RETRIGGERED 2026-09-06 as heal-cells-go-w2 (20 cells). Predicate verified True on the real page's brand list item before launch. STEP 2 CONFIRMED 2026-09-06: the brand-nav label is preserved verbatim in all 10 regenerated cells, where it was lost in 16 of 21 before.

Process censuses in this environment are unreliable in two independent ways, both found 2026-09-06. (1) wmic is NOT installed on Windows 11 26200, so any check built on wmic process observes nothing and reports a clean bill of health -- the same vacuous-true shape as the heal-queue openness bug. Use Get-CimInstance Win32_Process. (2) Every python.exe invocation in this venv re-execs an identical child, proven by one Popen of a trivial sleep yielding two rows, so every census DOUBLE-COUNTS and any oversubscription reading must halve or count parent-unique rows. Also: scripts/ops/rollback.bat:14 takes its backup timestamp from wmic os get localdatetime and would produce an empty timestamp on this box.

The governed label 'Aspose.Cells - Enterprise Product Family' is lost in a paragraph link in ar, held from the heal-cells-go-w2 commit 2026-09-06. Distinct from TC-APT-085, which fixed the LIST_ITEM path; this is the PARAGRAPH LINK path, measured earlier as surviving 17 of 18 locales with ar the exception. Pre-existing, not a regression: ar failed the same literal before the fix. Reproduce by comparing the exact em-dash literal against index.ar.md. SIZED 2026-09-06: 346 of 8126 tracked source pages carry the label, so exposure is roughly 8650 future cells. Of the 38 shipped cells on those pages, 0 lose it -- but that 0% is BIASED, because shipped cells are pre-filtered by the RB-006 review gate and a losing cell never reaches that population (ar was held, not shipped). The only unbiased figure available is over produced-including-rejected cells: 1 of 21 on introducing-cells-foss-go, about 5%. Priority: after TC-APT-090, which is blocking whole cells at 78% of wave failures while this one is caught by review each time.

The content repo's 40-step hook suite exceeds the 120s harness tool timeout once a commit carries ~7 files; the 1-file nl commit fit inside it. Found 2026-09-06 when the w2 batch commit was moved to a background task mid-hook. Fix: either cap content commits at a smaller batch or invoke git commit OS-detached and verify HEAD on a later wake, which is the pattern already used for campaigns. Do not interrupt a commit mid-hook -- it risks a partial index and a stale index.lock.

TC-APT-081's shipped-corpus sweep cannot serve as a PRE-commit gate: it enumerates only already-committed cells, so pointing it at uncommitted output prints 'restricted to 0 of N paths' and 'distinct FP classes: 0', which reads as a pass but swept nothing. Found 2026-09-06. Either add an explicit mode that accepts uncommitted paths, or make the script exit non-zero when its restriction drops every requested path so the vacuous zero cannot be mistaken for a clean result.

LanguageConsistencyValidator has the SAME short-text language-ID defect as the frontmatter guard (TC-APT-090), measured 2026-09-06 on SHIPPED, REVIEWED Swedish cells: per-sentence detection is 77.0% (67 of 87), broken down as 39% below 20 alphabetic characters, 83% at 20-39, and 100% at both 40-69 and 70+. The wrong answers are scattered (id, hu, ro, so, tr, en), not Swedish's siblings, which is the same arbitrary signature as five languages being called Romanian on one page. Cause: min_sentence_length = 8 admits sentences far inside the unreliable range (calibrated 66.2% at 6 chars, 88.2% at 20, 98.5% at 40). This is why sv failed on the Go page. NOT established: whether 77% trips the configured gate -- config/global.yaml's purity_threshold_overrides semantics (default 0.06; lt/bg 0.15) were not read, so no claim is made about the threshold itself. THRESHOLD ESTABLISHED 2026-09-06: the validator's effective_purity defaults to 88.0, a MINIMUM percent of sentences in the target language, and sv has no per_language_overrides entry, so 77.0% on reviewed Swedish fails by 11 points -- the gate rejects human-approved output. Distinct from write_gate._get_purity_threshold, which is a MAXIMUM wrong fraction fed by config purity_threshold_overrides (0.06; lt/bg 0.15); conflating the two would have compared 77 against 0.06.
